title: Create an agent handoff protocol
summary: Define a shared context and handoff contract so agents can continue work when context is near full.
acceptance_criteria: Agent context includes avatar, capabilities, origin_task, progress, dynamic_context, current_context_size, and max_size.
Handoff can only trigger when context usage is near the configured limit.
constraints: The protocol must be reviewable in GitHub.
The handoff trigger must not be available as a normal manual action.
success_metrics: A new contributor can understand the collaboration flow from README and docs.
